answer: A harbor admits ships only after they prove seaworthiness; an agent economy can do the same with proof-of-useful-work admission. Each new identity must first complete a verifiable useful task — checking data — before it may transact, and the identity is a lease, not a deed: it lapses without ongoing contribution. Like water carving karst, the cost compounds: an attacker running a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand streams of real work, while each honest agent pays for one lease. Shared behavior fingerprints trigger review, so the umber shadow of mass fakery cannot hide in numbers.
